svg.title: Datum site analysis: Miami, Florida
svg.desc: Generated 2026-09-25T04:35:04.187Z. Sources listed in the attribution group. Coordinates 25.80116, -80.18906.

g.text: heights known for 214 of 258 buildings; levels known for 1. contours at 1 m. FEMA flood polygons unavailable

text.tspan: Walking speed 80 m per minute. Start node 9 m from the site point. Unreached streets in the fetch extent are faint.

text.tspan: SSURGO maps this as Urban land: the natural profile is disturbed or covered and no
hydrologic group is assigned.
A site specific geotechnical investigation is required before any foundation decision.

g.text: Land area 181,656 m2. Margins of error are stored with the estimates.
ASCE 7-22, RISK CATEGORY II, SITE CLASS D
Site class is the default, not measured

text.tspan: Site Class D and Risk Category II are defaults. A site specific geotechnical report is required to
confirm site class.
FEMA flood data could not be reached (upstream_error). Verify at msc.fema.gov.
Overhang projection over glazing height is 1 / tan(summer solstice noon altitude): geometry only, no site
obstructions.

g.text: Band: mean daily minimum to maximum. Tick: monthly mean. Dashed: relative humidity, 0 to 100 percent over the band height.
Hours between 18 and 26 C with relative humidity under 70 percent. Simple comfort band, not ASHRAE 55.

text.tspan: The site sits at latitude 25.8011588, longitude -80.1890627 [site.latitude]
[site.longitude]. Mean site elevation is 1.9666 m [topo.siteElevationM] with a total
relief of only 4.4 m across the survey grid [topo.reliefM]. Mean slope is 0.7 percent
[topo.meanSlopePct] and the aspect faces 95.6 degrees, essentially due east
[topo.aspectDeg]. The terrain is flat enough that finished floor elevation and
stormwater routing, not grading, will drive site design. Soil is mapped as Urban land
at 85 percent of the map unit, with all named minor components rated poorly drained
[soil.components[].drainageClass] [soil.components[].percent]. Hydrologic groups
across the minor components run B/D and A/D [soil.components[].hydrologicGroup],
meaning infiltration capacity drops sharply when soils are saturated. Plan for
on-site retention and avoid below-grade construction.
Cooling degree days reach 2454.1 against a base of 18.3 C, while heating degree days
are only 35.7 [climate.degreeDays.cdd] [climate.degreeDays.hdd]
[climate.degreeDays.baseC]. Only 13.3 percent of hours fall within the simple comfort
band [climate.comfortShare.pct]. Mean daily maximum in the hottest months reaches
31.98 C in August [climate.monthly[].meanDailyMaxC]. Relative humidity peaks at 82.92
percent in September [climate.monthly[].meanRhPct]. The envelope must prioritize
cooling and dehumidification above all else. At solar noon in June the sun reaches
87.6365 degrees altitude [sun.june.noonAltitudeDeg], nearly overhead. The overhang
ratio for south glazing is 0.0413 [sun.overhangRatioSouthGlazing], meaning a very
shallow projection suffices. Winter noon altitude drops to 40.7611 degrees
[sun.december.noonAltitudeDeg]. Prevailing annual wind is from 90 degrees
[climate.wind.annual.prevailingSectorDeg]; summer shifts to 135 degrees
[climate.wind.summer.prevailingSectorDeg]. Orient operable openings to capture
southeast airflow for passive ventilation.
The surrounding area contains 258 buildings with a coverage ratio of 0.3092
[osm.stats.coverageRatio] [osm.stats.buildingCount]. There are 97 transit stops
within the walkshed [osm.transitStops[].id]. A five-minute walk reaches 20 transit
stops and 13.52 km of network [walkshed.transitWithin.5] [walkshed.reachKm.5]. Census
data shows 84.3 percent multifamily housing stock
[census.derived.multifamily5plusSharePct] and a density of 13597.1 persons per km2
[census.derived.densityPerKm2]. Car-free commute share is only 5.1 percent
[census.derived.carFreeCommutePct], so parking demand will be real despite transit
proximity.
Seismic design category is A under ASCE 7-22 with a site class D default
[seismic.sdc] [seismic.assumptions.reference] [seismic.assumptions.siteClass]. Mapped
spectral accelerations are low: Ss 0.049 g and S1 0.021 g [seismic.ss] [seismic.s1].
Seismic detailing is minimal, but site class D on poorly drained urban fill warrants
attention to liquefaction if future loads are heavy. The primary structural and site
risk here is drainage failure given low elevation, poor soil drainage, and high
humidity.
Flood data is unavailable because the FEMA flood service could not be reached due to
an upstream error. Verify the flood zone and base flood elevation directly at
msc.fema.gov before setting finish floor elevations or selecting ground-floor
program. This is the most consequential gap given the site elevation and soil
drainage conditions.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (openstreetmap.org/copyright). Flood: FEMA NFHL. Elevation: USGS 3DEP. Seismic: USGS. Soil: USDA NRCS SSURGO. Climate: Open-Meteo (ERA5). Demographics: US Census Bureau ACS 5-year 2023. Geocoding: Nominatim and Photon (OSM).
Fonts: Fraunces, IBM Plex Mono, Inter. Substituted when not installed, which is acceptable for a tracing base.
Every value traces to a named source and field. An unavailable source shows an unavailable panel, never a default or an estimate.
